title: Phase 2 ChatGPT run (plan Section 7.4, milestone I7)
note: Concrete for the staging shop "ChatGPT run 2", filled by scripts/chatgpt-run-shop.ts; the expected answers are in docs/phase-2-status.md Section 6. Tool and action names are the current ones (apps/worker/test/mcp-tools.test.ts). A step without an action accepts any action of its tool; `or` lists other calls that also do. Prompts 1 to 14 run on a full-access connection, in one chat, in this order; 13 and 14 are optional (they need a Shopify development store connected to the shop). Prompt 15 runs on a read-only connection. Check with: pnpm chatgpt-run --shop "ChatGPT run 2" --from <start> --expect docs/chatgpt-runs/phase-2.json
